latest_draw_update_policy.source_name: Official South African National Lottery results

provenance_qualified_operational_state.purpose: Permit operational XTRA rows independently corroborated from public result histories to enter the ledger when the configured official source is unavailable or stale, while retaining explicit pending-official-verification flags.
provenance_qualified_operational_state.rule: Do not strip pending_official_source_verification flags or represent these rows as official-source verified until the configured official source is successfully checked.

notes: The active HEPS XTRA lane begins with the South African PowerBall XTRA series on 2026-06-02.
